app.name: Chlat-Park
app.description: Manual, guard-assisted motorcycle parking entry and exit — a paper ticket replaced by a QR-linked e-ticket.

common.notFoundDescription: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
common.comingSoonDescription: This surface is part of the platform build-out. It is not implemented yet.

home.title: Parking, without the paper ticket
home.subtitle: Scan the entry QR, get an e-ticket, and the guard verifies it at the exit.
home.centralRule: A QR identifies a claim or a ticket. The trusted system decides whether it is valid — never the QR itself.
home.guestCta: I am parking — claim my ticket
home.guardCta: I am the guard — open the dashboard

step1.title: Entry
step1.body: The guard records the plate and issues an entry QR. The paper ticket is gone.

step2.title: Claim
step2.body: The guest scans the QR and receives an e-ticket bound to the plate and the session.

step3.title: Exit
step3.body: The guard scans the e-ticket. The system confirms the payment and the release.

entry.title: Guard dashboard
entry.subtitle: Record an entry, issue the QR, and verify the exit.

login.title: Guard sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in with the account the site manager created for you.
login.suspended: This account is suspended. Contact your site manager.

claim.title: Claim your e-ticket
claim.subtitle: Scan the QR code the guard gave you at the entrance.
claim.heading: Claim your parking ticket
claim.instructions: Point your camera at the entry QR. The ticket is issued to this device and shown at the exit.
claim.codePlaceholder: Paste the code from the QR
claim.alreadyClaimed: This entry QR has already been claimed.
claim.expired: This entry QR has expired. Please ask the guard for a new one.
claim.noQr: No QR code found in the camera view.

success.title: Your ticket is ready
success.body: Show this ticket to the guard when you leave the parking area.
